两层三间 · 元大德十年重建

Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: Ciyun Ge, the surviving Yuan-dynasty pavilion at Dingxing, Hebei, rebuilt 1306, matching the real photo. Landscape 1536x1024. Two storeys, THREE structural bays across each face, TWO broad tiled hipped roof/eave levels, upper roof wider and dominant, strongly projecting bracket sets at upper eaves. Square-plan compact timber pavilion: tall mostly plain solid-wall ground level with central lattice doorway, a narrow upper window/lattice band between roofs. Keep the visible Yuan bracket structure simplified yet distinct and the deep cantilevered upper roof. Change photo viewpoint to a near-front elevation with slight glimpse of right side, verticals vertical, enough distant viewpoint so apex, all four roof corners and small simple ground footing fit fully in frame. Remove metal street fence, hanging laundry, car, poles/wires and surrounding houses. DO NOT add an invented monumental stair, a large raised temple terrace, extra storeys, extra eaves, a Buddhist finial or a modern protective pavilion. The ground level is not an open colonnade. Preserve the three-bay rhythm, central ground doorway and second-storey lattice windows. Sparse black fine contours, predominantly empty white roof slopes, a few selected rafter and bracket lines only.

site_recommendation.name: 慈云阁
site_recommendation.yearNote: 原大悲阁群只存此阁；元大德十年重建。
site_recommendation.lede: 定兴旧城的慈云阁以两层木构托起舒展的重檐，阁内外仍保留元代构架的特点。原寺建筑多已消失，这座小阁独自记录着大悲阁的旧名。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 现阁重建于元大德十年（1306），属于元代木构遗存。

facts.label: 格局
facts.text: 面阔、进深各三间，平面近方，两层楼阁式。

facts.label: 构架
facts.text: 梁架结合垂柱、抹角梁等做法，保留元代结构与制作手法。

quality_check.notes: 两层三间、上下两道檐口和完整小型基座；去掉街道围栏和车辆，未增大台阶。
